It has Morning and Night Prayers, Bible Trivia, AI Priest (The AI priest I didn’t trust at first, but I gave it a hard question I already knew, and it pulls your answer from the Bible verse, and a little bit of the internet, but mostly Bible verses, anyways, it gave me the correct answer, so if you have a question, go to the AI priest, or your Bible.), Morning and Night Devotions, Your Prayers ( You type your prayers and click save and pray and you have a time to focus on your prayers.), and my plan. Because a number of years ago I had a stroke [at only age 21], and while I’m recuperating rather well from it (thanks only to our Lord God Almighty!), my eyes are still screwed up quite a bit.
